title: Hello, World!
content:
Welcome to my terminal blog. This is where I'll share thoughts, technical notes, and random musings.

Feel free to explore and check back for updates.

title: Setting Up This Blog
content:
I wanted a blog that felt different from the typical Medium or WordPress setup. Something that reflected my personality as a developer.

So I built this terminal-themed blog. It's simple, it's fast, and it doesn't require any backend or database. Just a JSON file that I can edit and push to GitHub.

The beauty of static sites.
